text:
marco: Morning team — small mystery: cookie jar was full-ish yesterday, empty today, lid left on the counter. who is our office cookie thief? :detective: 
tess: guilty. grabbed three during the late standup. my bad on the lid. :grimacing:
ashley: can we set a simple rule? "close lids" is basically one sentence. also maybe a note about allergens.
ron: coin jar? 50c per cookie feels fair. could automate with Venmo but coin jar vibes are nicer.
carmen: i'm allergic to tree nuts so pls label. one jar labeled "nut-free" would be great.
marco: agreed. i can pick up a small airtight jar and some labels tonight. cheap and quick.
tess: also, idea: tiny sticker on the jar with emoji to show contents: 🍪 for regular, 🌰 if contains nuts, ✅ if nut-free. visual and fast.
ashley: love the emoji approach. avoids long notes.
ops-bot: pantry-funds: balance $7.85. flagged low items: almond milk, sparkling water. Would you like me to create a shopping request? Reply with 'ops: shop' or 'ops: hold'.
ron: ops: shop
marco: i'll grab the jar + labels and toss in $5 to pantry. bringing tonight.
carmen: i'll bring a sealed nut-free cookie box on Monday so we have a backup.
tess: poll: 50c vs $1 per cookie? people vote with emoji :thumbsup: 50c, :heart: $1
ashley: :thumbsup:
marco: :thumbsup:
ron: :heart: (i'm a monster)
ocps-bot: (typo)
ops-bot: noted. created shopping ticket #452 for almond milk, sparkling water, airtight cookie jar, masking tape, and labels.
marco: also found some mystery Tupperware in the fridge labeled "sauce?" from last year. friendly reminder: please add name + date. i'll leave a roll of masking tape + sharpie in the cutlery drawer.
tess: can we add a 3-rule sticky to the pantry? i'll draft: 1) Label perishables name+date; 2) Reseal jars/close lids; 3) Put 50c in coin jar if taking communal snacks.
ashley: short and sweet. post it by the coffee station and we're golden.
ron: who wants the leftover banana bread on my desk? first come.
carmen: me pls :raised_hands: 
marco: thanks everyone. small civility beats passive-aggression. :coffee:
